title: Trophic mobility and distinct organ-specific toxicity of rare earth oxide (REO) nanoparticles in a freshwater food chain
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00015K, Paper
Yiyun Liu, Qin-Hong Zhou, Yuan Ding, Feng-Yi Guo, Si-Jia Zuo, Chuan Wang, Shi-Jie Chen, Dongmei Xie, De-Sheng Pei
Based on a three-tier aquatic food chain confirmed that lanthanum oxide and cerium oxide nanoparticles can undergo bioaccumulation and migration along the food chain, damaging the liver and heart of fish, respectively.
